unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U25: Distinguish information institutions,PIO designation and disclosure safeguards

payload.title: Use the correct institution and dated exemption text
payload.core_explanation_md:
The public authority designates its information officers; the Central and State Information Commissions are distinct institutions with the relevant jurisdiction. Appropriate Government depends on the statutory relationship to the authority. A commission does not replace the authority own initial request process.

Disclosure is not a universal release of all banking records. Commercial confidence, fiduciary material and personal information require the relevant exemption, public-interest and procedural analysis. For the June2026 cutoff, the DPDP commencement notification brings section 44(3) into force on publication, and that provision replaces RTI8(1)(j) with the personal-information clause. The textbook earlier wording must not be taught as the unchanged current clause. This does not eliminate the separate section 8(2) public-interest analysis or permit an unexplained blanket refusal.

self_check.prompt_text: Who designates the PIO for a public authority?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The public authority under the applicable statutory framework.

payload.stem_md: A bank says all RTI requests can be rejected merely by writing confidential, without identifying a provision or reasons. What is required?

options.text_md: A confidentiality stamp alone settles every case
options.explanation_md: It does not replace legal analysis.

options.text_md: All banking information must always be released
The requester must prove a commercial benefit
options.explanation_md: No such universal test is stated.

options.text_md: The applicable dated exemption, public-interest and procedural reasoning
options.explanation_md: The decision must have a statutory basis.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The decision must have a statutory basis.

payload.stem_md: An exam draft uses the old personal-information clause after the applicable section 44(3) commencement. What must the author do?

options.text_md: Apply the amended clause with the commencement evidence and separate safeguards
options.explanation_md: Versioned law determines the relevant framework.

options.text_md: Assume every DPDP provision commenced simultaneously

options.explanation_md: The amendment changes a clause, not the existence of the framework.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Versioned law determines the relevant framework.
